title: Name Validation Handling Fee on Harborline Domains
content:
**Domain team fee note — name validation handling fee on SSL/TLS Certificates added names**

Each name added to an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription carries a name validation handling fee as part of its added-name charge. Where the certificate's linked domain is a Harborline domain registration, the fee follows that registration's status and nameservers as the Domain Registrations records show them.

## Fee by the linked registration

| Linked Domain Registrations record | Name validation handling fee |
|---|---|
| a Harborline registration in status active, on Harborline DNS | waived — validation there completes automatically |
| a Harborline registration in status active, on external nameservers | 2.00 |
| any other case | no reduction of the handling fee applies |

"Any other case" covers a certificate whose domain is registered elsewhere (no linked Harborline registration) and a linked Harborline registration whose status is anything other than active, whatever its nameservers.

## Reading the records

- The registration read is the Domain Registrations holding the certificate subscription names as its linked domain — not any other domain the customer holds.
- Both parts must hold for the waiver: the registration is active **and** its nameservers are Harborline DNS.
- Both parts must hold for the 2.00 fee: the registration is active **and** its nameservers are external.

## Hypothetical cases

- A certificate for store.example is linked to an active Harborline registration of store.example on Harborline DNS: the handling fee of each added name is waived.
- The same registration is moved to external nameservers and stays active: each added name's handling fee is 2.00.
- A certificate for ledger.example, whose domain is registered with another registrar: no reduction of the handling fee applies.
